text:
rachel: CI spike: dozens of SAST jobs show "owner: unknown" and decrypt errors after infra group cleanup last night. anyone else seeing KMS 403s?

sam: yep, same. Build logs: PermissionDenied on decrypt for serviceAccount:code-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com

scanner-bot: job:sast-2201 -> ERROR PermissionDenied: projects/rdw-prod/.../cryptoKeys/sast-key: decrypt denied for serviceAccount:code-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com

leo: I merged a group tidying PR yesterday (PR#4270) that removed a nested group. I didn't touch keystore bindings directly but this could be the cause.

rachel: log snippet:
```
403 PermissionDenied: Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' denied for serviceAccount:code-scanner@...
```

sec-oncall: Opening incident channel #inc-412345-keystore. Immediate fix: temporarily add roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to code-scanner SA and re-run failing jobs. Also capture audit logs for the IAM change.

sam: quick gcloud to re-add:
`gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding sast-key --location=global --keyring=keystore --member=serviceAccount:code-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --project=rdw-prod`

audit-bot: Found IAM change at ts=4123456700 by infra-automation@redwood-inference removing group membership that resolved to code-scanner. Log id: projects/rdw-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity/entries/xyz123. Retention=30d.

sec-oncall: Root cause = group resolution change removed effective binding. Actions: emergency RBAC restore (done), backfill scans (rachel/sam), add presubmit test that verifies scanner SA has decrypt, extend keystore audit retention to 90d and add alert on KMS IAM mutations, update SDLC runbook for infra group changes.

rachel: Starting backfill now, will post results. Mark findings within the gap window as "delayed-verify" until owners confirm.

sec-oncall: Triage complete. RFC and runbook PR to follow. :white_check_mark:
